Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the change: keeping private keys and password-derived hashes out of authentication logs. This matches the summary, which describes removing private-key and hash or text input from log calls in pkgs/identity/auth/auth.go and adding a test that guards those logger calls. The title's `#6181` reference points to the linked issue. The title is about 85 characters, so it is a bit long but still clear.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** All changed code is in pkgs/identity/auth. The diff removes credential values from seven log calls. It adds one AST guard test in the same package, which checks those log calls. Storage statements and lookup logic are unchanged. The changes implement the auth-package part of `#6181` and do not introduce unrelated behavior.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** Issue `#6181` requires that no credential material reach authentication logs. It also requires acceptance tests that capture logs during SSH password auth, keyboard-interactive auth, and /set-cookie with a valid JWT, and assert that each sentinel credential is absent. It also requires error-path coverage for invalid tokens. Verified at head, in pkgs/identity/auth/auth.go (diff against merge base): the seven log calls in InsertPrivateKey, InsertHashPublicKey, GetPublicKeyFromHash, InsertTextPublicKey, GetPublicKeyFromText, and GetPublicKey no longer log privateKeyString, hash, text, or password values. They log only key type, hash_type, text_type, and public key strings. The base64 and privateKeyString usages remain only for storage. Verified at head, in pkgs/identity/auth/auth_logging_test.go: a new AST guard checks logger calls in those six functions for credential-bearing identifiers and string fields. This is a static check, not the runtime log-capture test with sentinel values that the issue specifies. Not verified: the SSH (pkgs/identity/cmd/ssh) and web (pkgs/identity/web) fixes that the PR description says already landed. This PR does not change those files. Their runtime log behavior and the invalid-token error-path behavior were not inspected at head within the inspection limit. Sentinel-based runtime log-capture tests were not found in this PR. **Resolution** Provide evidence for the SSH password, keyboard-interactive, and /set-cookie log paths at head. Show that they emit no credential values. Show runtime or sentinel-based log-capture tests for those paths, or for the auth package. Show error-path coverage where invalid-token errors do not echo the submitted credential.
